emendations.description: Source emendations applied before parsing; source_span is the extent of emended in the decoded source after emendation.

layout_blocks.description: Source scopes in postorder: when ranges coincide, the inner scope precedes its enclosing scope.

table_rules.description: The source states that the supplied table has no rules, an explicit absence rather than an unstated one.

source_kind.description: The translated source is supplied banknote lettering, without an inferred image identifier or language.

placement.description: Supplied placement below a figure or table; it does not identify an associated figure.

node_range.description: Half-open indices into nodes, delimiting one enclosing source layout scope independently of heading and paragraph roles.

first_line_indent.description: Indent in characters of the scope's first line, where the source states it apart from the scope indent.

column_rule.description: The source supplies a rule between columns, without stroke dimensions or color.

page_vertical_placement.description: Supplied position between the page head and foot, for the text up to the next page break.

column_number.description: One-based column that the scope holds alone.

offset_chars.description: Supplied fullwidth-character distance from the anchor lower edge.

span.$comment: Half-open UTF-8 byte offsets in the converter's parser text projection, before publication whitespace filtering. parser_text_utf8 includes structural and source-note text traversed by the converter. reading_utf8 is local to the containing ruby reading; each nested ruby reading owns a new axis starting at zero. witness_utf8 is local to the containing base-text alternative, starting at zero independently of the principal text and ruby readings. annotation_utf8 is local to each target-associated editorial note, independently of its principal target. proposed_utf8 is local to the proposed reading of an editorial correction. None of these axes is the decoded source or final plaintext. end must be greater than or equal to start.

sourceSpan.$comment: Exact half-open UTF-8 byte extent in the complete decoded source, including source markup. Source extents are absent when an exact mapping is unknown, including newly split fragments. line and column refer to the source and are 1-based when known.

source_byte_range.description: Range in the detector input, on the enclosing bundle parser_text_utf8 axis.

anchor.description: Where along the target the source located the mark. Independent of position, which is the physical side: the source states the two separately. Absent when the mark accompanies the target as a whole.

direction.description: Ruby reading placement relative to base text: left (before base) or right (after base).

reading_children.description: Structured ruby reading content. Reading spans use reading_utf8 relative to this ruby reading, not the body axis. source_span locates exact decoded source extents when known.
